title: Add product stock tracking
goal: Extend the existing product catalog prototype with stock quantity on products and an availability filter based on stock quantity.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product catalog create, edit, list, name/SKU search, and category filter behavior remains working.
User can enter stock quantity when creating a product.
User can edit stock quantity for an existing product.
Product list displays stock quantity or a clear stock/availability indication for each product.
User can filter products by availability: in stock and out of stock.
Backend API, service, storage, pytest, and Playwright tests are updated for the new stock behavior without creating a separate product catalog screen.
constraints: Use the previous products-app run as the baseline via --from-run.
Preserve existing /api/products route and existing product catalog screen route.
Prefer modifying existing product files over creating duplicate product catalog files.
No inventory reservation, supplier integration, order management, or warehouse workflow.
No database migrations; continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Do not implement inventory reservations or stock history.
Do not add a separate warehouse screen.
Do not replace existing search/category filtering with a different UI pattern.
